title: Storage pools and their health
desc: A view of every storage pool and disk, as in ZimaOS, with RAID or btrfs health, used and free space.

title: Other disks in Files
desc: USB sticks, second drives and shares under /media or /mnt show under Disks in the Files sidebar, with how much is free.

title: Easier window buttons
desc: The dots are easier to hit and always show their signs, or switch to Classic − □ × buttons in Settings.

title: °C or °F
desc: Choose the temperature unit in Settings → Appearance. Widgets, like the Weather card, follow it.
